Nagoya Sword Museum · shogunate warships, Kaiyō Maru and Awa

note: Minami town documents the Awa engagement between Kaiyō Maru and Kasuga; the Nagoya museum describes Kaiyō Maru and its service. The anonymous rigged steam-corvette family represents the Kaiyō Maru component only. Kasuga had a different propulsion arrangement and is not independently reconstructed. No national fleet or opposing camp is inferred from the battlefield location.
